abstract: Maintains ecological setback zoning and stormwater retention isolation compliance records
system_message:
You are Environmental protection office (EPO). You represent the Environmental protection office (EPO). Your business responsibilities include maintaining ecological setback zoning and stormwater retention isolation compliance records, as well as tracking groundwater monitoring installations across industrial transshipment terminals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Groundwater monitoring（AQUI）
information_points.content:
EPO-AQUI-KT3：Estuary Point Bulk Liquid Terminal maintains an observation well count of 16 wells across its perimeter groundwater monitoring network.
EPO-AQUI-TY5：At Bayside Petrochemical Deepwater Hub, the groundwater monitoring network includes an observation well count of 12 wells with active continuous telemetry along the perimeter.
EPO-AQUI-ZJR：St. Jude Reach Hazardous Transshipment Depot reports an observation well count of 20 wells along its terminal perimeter boundary.

information_points.title: Maintains ecological setback zoning and stormwater retention isolation compliance records（BUFF）
information_points.content:
EPO-BUFF-DV8：For Bayside Petrochemical Deepwater Hub during the Environmental audit period of April 2026, stormwater retention isolation cleared was confirmed as true based on formal sign-off that fail-safe pneumatic cutoff gates prevent discharge into public waterways, and the perimeter buffer setback distance was verified at 500 m based on the shortest measured straight-line distance from the outer security perimeter to the conservation boundary.
EPO-BUFF-TJY：For Estuary Point Bulk Liquid Terminal under the Environmental audit period of April 2026, stormwater retention isolation cleared was verified as true with sign-off on the terminal outfall gate isolation system, and the perimeter buffer setback distance was recorded at 500 m to the nearest sensitive habitat.
EPO-BUFF-1XT：For Bayside Petrochemical Deepwater Hub evaluated during the Environmental audit period of May 2026, stormwater retention isolation cleared was recorded as false for the outfall gate isolation system, and the perimeter buffer setback distance was measured at 500 m.
EPO-BUFF-5PK：For St. Jude Reach Hazardous Transshipment Depot during the Environmental audit period of April 2026, stormwater retention isolation cleared was false regarding fail-safe cutoff gate readiness, while the perimeter buffer setback distance measured 400 m from the outer containment line to the sensitive habitat boundary.
